response.rationale: CD138+ with CD20-/PAX5- and EBV+ strongly favors plasmablastic lymphoma; CD56+ is atypical but not exclusive, while NK/T-cell lymphoma typically lacks CD138.

rejected.why: CD138 positivity is not characteristic of NK/T-cell lymphoma, and the immunophenotype plus FISH gains (BCL6/MYC/IGH) better fit plasmablastic lymphoma.
